{{Location disambiguation 2|disambigdesc=the [[explorable area]]|disambigarticle=Gandara, the Moon Fortress}} {{Mission infobox | name = Pogahn Passage | campaign = Nightfall | region = Kourna | type = Cooperative | requiredhero = Margrid the Sly | duration = Short | preceded by = [[No Me, No Kormir]] | followed by = [[Moddok Crevice]]
[[A Thorn in Varesh's Side]] }} [[Kormir]] has been captured! She is to be executed, but with the assistance of [[Margrid the Sly]], you've managed to secure a set of [[Kourna]]n armor and plan on infiltrating [[Gandara]] to rescue her. As her price, Margrid asks that you also help her acquire the Diadem of [[Lady Glaive]] from the base's vault. After which you will proceed to the prison, break out Kormir, and rush to the docks to escape. This mission represents a branch in the storyline which is determined by your choice of [[Margrid the Sly]] or [[Master of Whispers]]. If you have chosen Master of Whispers, you may return to this mission after completing [[Abaddon's Gate]] or enter with someone who has Margrid the Sly. ==Mission information== ===Requirements=== * All party members must have accepted the reward for [[No Me, No Kormir]] or [[To Kill a Demon]]. * [[Margrid the Sly]] must be present in the party. ===Objectives=== Rescue Kormir from Gandara. * Escort Margrid to the Gandaran treasure vault to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive. * Free Kormir from the Kournan prison. * Escape from Gandara with Kormir and Shahai. * Optional: Escort the [[Sunspear Prisoner|Sunspear prisoners]] to the prison. * Optional: Obtain the prison code for entry into the prison. * Optional: The demon is out of control! You can either help the guards or stand aside and let them fight on their own. * Optional: Take over gate duty for some guards. * *[[Bonus|BONUS]]* Complete optional objectives. ===Rewards=== {{Mission rewards|Nightfall | Reputation = Sunspear | Objective = Optional objectives accomplished | ObjNMstd = 0 - 2 | ObjNMexp = 3 | ObjNMmstr = 4 | ObjHMstd = 0 - 2 | ObjHMexp = 3 | ObjHMmstr = 4 | PtsNMstd = 20 | PtsNMexp = 20 | PtsNMmstr = 20 | PtsHMstd = 70 | PtsHMexp = 70 | PtsHMmstr = 70 }} == Walkthrough == Your party starts under the [[Kournan Guardsman]] effect, disguised as Kournan guards to avoid early confrontations. During this time, players can accomplish the bonus objectives which are very simple. Proceed to the treasure vault (point 5) to trigger Margrid's dialogue to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive and now head to the prison gate (point 6). [[Prison Keeper Shelkesh]] will ask the code to clear passage. * If you acquired the password from the guard at the entrance of the fort, you can pass through unobstructed. * However, should you not have the password or choose the option to give the wrong password, the 3 hostile Kournans will spawn, and Shelkesh will turn hostile, although he will not move or attack. The gate will open when all 4 foes are dead. Upon reaching the prison, kill [[Jailer Gahanni]] and the other guards and a [[cinematic]] will start (point 7). Now, you have fifteen minutes to escape by reaching the docks with Kormir and Shahai. The exit can be found in only half the counter's time so there is no need to rush through as the clock may imply. There are two deadly spots: * The second and third Kournan groups after crossing back the bridge: Players will find the second group to be small and static, but a third larger group is on its way towards the bridge. Instead of engaging the second group, wait until the third climbs the stairs and move far ahead from the second group. This will help avoid over-aggroing and having to fight a large mob with two Kournan Priests healing each other. Since [[Margrid the Sly]] is a required hero, she can be used to lure the third group ([[flag]] and un-flag), because if a player attempts to pull, Kormir and Shahai will follow, risking mission failure. After dispatching these groups, you may either travel north through the fort or south along the docks, both paths rejoin at the dock. * The final battle at the docks has four static guards and another group behind them lead by [[Captain Nebo]], a powerful elementalist boss capable of dealing massive area damage with [[Fire Magic]] spells. Lure the four guards first to reduce enemies and only then engage the last group. Finally, walk to the end of the dock to complete the mission. === Bonus === These are four tasks that need to be accomplished before Kormir and Shahai's cinematic: * Talk to [[Guard Captain Kahturin]] to obtain the prison code. * Talk to [[Captain Nahnkos]] to escort [[Sunspear Prisoners]], who will assist in battles but are not required to survive. * Trigger the Kourna Guards dialogue involving the [[Demon Spawn]], either helping them or not will count as done. * Talk to [[Guard Linko]] to take over gate duty. You don't need to watch them leave nor stay, just continue with the mission. === Skill recommendations === * If your party has anyone that deals damage via [[attack]]s, consider bringing skills that [[Stance#Skills countering stances|remove stances]], [[List of skills which bypass blocking|bypass blocking]] or [[List of blocking punishment skills|punish blocking]] to use against the [[Kournan Bowman]], who use [[Whirling Defense]]. * The final elementalist boss is dangerous to the [[NPC]]s you must keep alive. ** [[Ward Against Harm]] and/or [[Ward Against Elements]] help reduce the damage, until they move outside the wards. [[Shelter]] and [[Union]] will also help keep the NPCs alive ** Interrupts also help against the boss. Since Margrid is required for the mission, equip her with [[Distracting Shot]] and/or [[Savage Shot]] and lock her on the boss to help suppress damage. * [[Enchantment]]-based [[build]]s are vulnerable to enchantment removal by [[Kournan Oppressor]]s and [[Kournan Seer|Seers]]. * [[List of hex removal skills|Hex removal skills]] could be unnecessary; the only [[hex spell]]s your party will encounter are [[Enchanter's Conundrum]] (the hex that is applied has no impact if your party does not use enchantments) and [[Life Siphon]] (ends when its caster dies). ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Captain Nahnkos]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Guard Captain Kahturin]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Kournan Captain]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Vault Master Eijah]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Guard Linko]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Jailer Gahanni]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Kournan Guard]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Prison Keeper Shelkesh]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Vabbi Guard (warrior)|Vabbi Guard]] *{{mo}} 20 (20) [[Shahai the Cunning]] *{{p}} 20 (20) [[Kormir]] *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Sunspear Prisoner]] *{{mo}} 20 (20) Sunspear Prisoner *{{p}} 20 (20) Sunspear Prisoner ===Foes=== [[Demon]] ([[Torment creature]]) *{{me}} 20 (29) [[Demon Spawn]] [[Human]]s ([[Kournan military]]) *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Jailer Gahanni]] *{{w}} 16, 20 (26) [[Kournan Guard]] (axe, sword, hammer) *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Prison Keeper Shelkesh]] *{{w}} 22 (26) [[Kournan Elite Guard]] *{{r}} 16, 20 (26) [[Kournan Bowman]] *{{mo}} 16, 20 (26) [[Kournan Priest]] *{{n}} 16, 20 (26) [[Kournan Oppressor]] *{{me}} 20 (26) [[Kournan Seer]] *{{e}} 20 (26) [[Kournan Scribe]] *{{e}} 22 (26) [[Kournan Elite Scribe]] *{{p}} 16, 20 (26) [[Kournan Phalanx]] *{{p}} 22 (26) [[Kournan Elite Spear]] *{{d}} 20 (26) [[Kournan Zealot]] *{{d}} 22 (26) [[Kournan Elite Zealot]] ====Bosses==== [[Human]]s ([[Kournan military]]) *{{me}} 24 (30) [[Lieutenant Nali]] → [[Enchanter's Conundrum]] *{{e}} 24 (30) [[Captain Nebo]] → [[Master of Magic]] *{{p}} 24 (30) [[Colonel Kajo]] → [[Cautery Signet]] ==Dialogue== ===Opening cinematic=== :See [[No Me, No Kormir (cinematic)]] ===Initial dialogue=== :'''Margrid the Sly''' ::''"Remember our deal, [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]]. I know where these Sunspears are going. Follow me."'' ==Notes== * Kormir follows the [[party]] leader, never [[attacks]] and rarely uses [[skill]]s except for [["Incoming!"]]. Foes cannot [[target]] her but she does take damage from [[area of effect]] skills. *Occasionally, Kormir and/or Shahai may get stuck in the prison around the bridge. Make sure they are following as they are required to reach the docks to complete the mission. *Before entering the fortress gate, you can explore the [[Gandara, the Moon Fortress]] area, which is completely free of foes. *There is a dialogue sequence between a [[Kournan Guard]] and a [[Kournan Captain]] that seems to be reversed, that is, the Guard speaks the Captain's lines, and the Captain, the Guard's. *Using your keyboard to move around during the end mission cinematic will contribute about 0.1% to the [[Elonian Cartographer]] title. *After completing this mission, your party will be taken to [[Moddok Crevice (outpost)|Moddok Crevice]]. *Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 in the [[Night Falls]] [[storybook]]. {{bug| Sometimes Guard Linko will not show up. In that case you will have to re-do the mission for the bonus.}} {{bug| Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male Kournan soldier even if they are female.}} {{bug| For some characters the map will not be uncovered during the cinematic, even after moving using the keyboard.}} {{bug| Sometimes the mission will fail when encountering the last group of enemies even without Kormir / Shahai dying and with time still available.}} {{bug| Of the two groups that have to be killed to free Kormir, the northern one will sometimes spawn inside of a prison cell, out of reach of melee attacks for both them and players.}} == Trivia == * [[Jora]], [[M.O.X]], [[Ogden Stonehealer]], [[Pyre Fierceshot]], [[Vekk]] and [[Zhed Shadowhoof]] will not be disguised. * There are numerous references to George Lucas' [[w:Star Wars|Star Wars]] series: ** Much of the dialogue involving Zhed Shadowhoof is similar to when Luke, Han and Chewbacca infiltrate the Death Star and go to the prison deck disguised as Stormtroopers performing a prison block transfer for a Wookie to cell block 1138. Zhed will prompt a dialogue and be disguised as a prisoner despite his expected protests. Later, you will end up telling [[Guard Captain Kahturin]] that you are transferring Zhed to cell block 1138. (from [[w:Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope|The 1977 film, A New Hope]]) ** The incorrect answer to Guard Captain Kahturin when gaining access to the prison is "Blue Harvest", the name of the cover movie used to hide the filming site for [[w:Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi|Return of the Jedi]]. (1138 is also similar to Lucas' first film, [[w:THX 1138|THX 1138]].) ** The password for the prison transfer, 20, 1, 8, and 7 is the same as Princess Leia's cell number, 2187 (from ''A New Hope'') ** "We're not the guards you're looking for" from the decline option of [[Captain Nahnkos]] mimics, ''"These are not the droids you are looking for"''. (from ''A New Hope'') * Other movies (and books) are also sources for other dialogue within the mission, including: ** [[w:Soylent Green|Soylent Green]]: A conversation between two guards: '''5:''' ''"It's worse than gruel...it's..."'' — '''6:''' ''"Soylent?"'' {{Nightfall missions}} [[Category:References to films & tv series]] [[de:Passage von Pogahn (Mission)]]
